title: Has one (large?) flaw.
text:
Has one (large?) flaw.. We got this to use on our daughter's upper bunk. While the cable is a bit short for our liking (it barely reaches to the other end of the lower bunk), we were able to make do. The one big flaw for us is that, because this fan is used on the upper bunk, the fan doesn't stay in a lower position. One slight touch or movement of the fan or cable and the fan immediately toggles upward. You have to be very gentle to keep it blowing downward.
We get that, because of the footprint of this fan, this is mean to blow upward. However, it would be beneficial for a fan of varying heights to be able to stay at each height without moving unintentionally.

product_metadata.title: IRIS USA WOOZOO Air Circulator Fan, Vortex Fan, Desk Fan, Portable Fan, 3 Speed Settings, 360 Tilting Head, 52ft Max Air Distance, Large, Gray
features: AIR CIRCULATION: Not just a fan. This circulator whips up and mixes the air throughout the room, to give you fresh air with less temperature variations. The modern aesthetic will fit in your bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, office, or any medium or small room. 52 ft of air flow on the top setting.
description: Maximize air flow in your house, office, or dorm with this WOOZOO fan. Three speed settings let you adjust air flow to your desired strength and the 360° vertical head tilt capabilities allow you to direct the flow of air in whichever way you please. The whole room fan is powerful enough to reach the corners of rooms, and the extra-quiet 'low' setting lets you study, sleep, or relax without any noise distractions. The desktop fan provides up to 275 ft² area coverage, and the 70.9 inch cord makes it easy to reach the nearest open outlet.

details.Care instructions: Wipe lightly using a soft cloth. For hard to remove dirt, wipe using a cloth containing a diluted neutral detergent.
